title: MUSA collection item record
description: Single contract of the collection layer, frozen as v1 (see schemas/COMPATIBILITY.md). See docs/Musa_design document_technical-specs_v1.1.md section 3.2 and docs/adr/0001-camada-de-acervo.md. A record that does not validate against this schema must not enter the index.

asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier. Also the folder name of the item.

data.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. BCE dates are negative numbers (e.g. -500).

dimensoes.description: Physical dimensions as free text (e.g. 30cm x 20cm).

colecao.description: Collection this item belongs to; must match a top-level folder under acervo/.

model_primary.description: Asset the frontend loads today (e.g. model.glb). Required when model_status is available.

model_source.description: Source asset for editing and archiving (e.g. asset.usda). Optional; absent in the GLB-only MVP.

model_formats.description: Formats actually available for this item.

model_viewer.description: Viewer that must be used to render model_primary.

model_status.description: State of the 3D pipeline for this item.

digital_twin_sala.description: Reference to the digital twin of the room where the piece is displayed.

embedding.description: Semantic embedding of the record, used for retrieval (RAG).
